title: Mandatory evidence retrieval must be enforced by control flow
environment: Observed Dify grounded workflow. The lesson does not require removing every model or claim that later external validation failures were solved.
goal: Require evidence retrieval and a valid handoff before producing grounded answers.
approach: Historical failed assumption: Prompts and generic helper tests were assumed to enforce mandatory operations and output contracts.
what_worked: Historical correction: Route required operations through fixed intent-specific tool nodes, validate untrusted results, gate remote work on parser success, and model non-evidence/failure outcomes explicitly. Verification reported by the source: Targeted search/detail/comparison checks improved to 10/10 and 5/5; 55 malformed inputs rejected and invalid-input remote calls stayed zero. Later soak still failed final validation, so overall architecture acceptance remained incomplete.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: An autonomous agent omitted the required tool in one of ten searches; valid handoffs were four of ten for search and zero of five for detail/comparison, while four existing tests passed.
why: Confirmed: operation choice and contract generation remained discretionary, with conflicting legacy instructions and missing graph guards.
improved_method: Make mandatory operations structural invariants. Test omitted-tool, malformed-result and failure paths in the actual graph; targeted success is not full-system acceptance.
when_to_use: Observed Dify grounded workflow. The lesson does not require removing every model or claim that later external validation failures were solved.
when_not_to_use: The lesson does not require removing every model or claim that later external validation failures were solved.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
